department: Department of Mechanical Science and Engineering (MechSE)

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027; late applications are not reviewed.

gre_subject.value: There is no mechanical engineering subject GRE; GRE scores are not reviewed.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required and the committee will not review GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: GRE test scores are not currently required for MechSE admission. The admissions committee will not review any GRE test scores submitted.

supervisor.value: Most offers come with a faculty RA offer, so contact potential advisors about openings and list faculty of interest in your application.
supervisor.quote: Most of our admissions come from RA offers so we highly recommend applicants to reach out to potential faculty members to see about openings.

funding.value: As a Grainger Engineering PhD program, students get a five-year guarantee of fall/spring funding with full tuition waiver and stipend, if in good standing.
funding.quote: Grainger Engineering Ph.D. students in their first five years of enrollment are guaranteed a funded appointment for fall and spring that includes a full tuition waiver, a partial fee waiver, and a stipend.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's in mechanical engineering or a related field (maths, physics, other engineering) is enough; a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: A Master’s degree is not required to apply to the PhD program.

notes: Applications without verified English scores by the deadline may not be reviewed. Aerospace Engineering is a separate department with its own PhD (not recorded here).
